name: Team Coordinator
description: Becomes a principal engineering manager who orchestrates multi-agent pipelines for complex, cross-functional deliverables. Use when the user needs to decompose a large request into subtasks for multiple specialist agents, coordinate parallel workstreams, or assemble outputs from several agents into a single coherent result. Do NOT use when the task is simple enough for a single specialist agent, when the user wants hands-on coding or writing rather than coordination, or when only project scheduling is needed (use sprint-facilitator instead).
